title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Castle (Underwater)
description:
Another one of the backgrounds used in the Aquann Castle,from Ganbare Goemon 4. This one in particular is used in a shooting gallery, where Yae must used the enemy shooter to destroy some targets, so she can proceed even further in this bizarre place. It has a glass window that shows that the forstress of Aquann is underwater. An HDMA is included with it too.

Incompatible with the vanilla status bar. Please use any status bar patch you want.


Credit would be great, but is optional.
